description: An agent-based, network-mediated simulation of mask-wearing adoption and maintenance under social influence, policies, information signals, and supply constraints. Agents (people) form daily contacts in venues, update attitudes via social influence and information, decide on mask use subject to policy enforcement and supply access, and develop habits over time. A small-world social network supports repeated interactions and spillovers.

modules.name: InformationUpdateModule
modules.description: Updates global risk signal and broadcasts information affecting individual risk perception and attitudes.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each day:
  # Update risk signal using an AR(1)-like process with exogenous cases proxy
  risk_signal_t = max(0, risk_signal_{t-1} + risk_signal_volatility * (cases_proxy_t - risk_signal_{t-1}))
  if state.policy_mandate_flag == True:
    risk_signal_t += 0.5 * message_strength
  # Broadcast to persons
  for person in Persons:
    media_bias = 1 if person.media_consumption_profile == 'public_health' else (0 if 'balanced' else -1)
    info_effect = media_effect_weight * news_salience_base * media_bias
    misinfo = misinformation_rate * (1 if person.media_consumption_profile == 'misinfo_prone' else 0)
    delta_risk = risk_perception_weight * (risk_signal_t / 100.0) + info_effect - misinfo
    person.risk_perception = clip(person.risk_perception + delta_risk, 0, 1)
    # Shift attitude in direction of risk perception
    person.attitude_toward_masks = clip(person.attitude_toward_masks + 0.2 * (person.risk_perception - 0.5), -2, 2)
  emit event.info_broadcast
notes: cases_per_100k_proxy may be fed by observed data or synthetic process.
Risk signal scaled to [0,100] per 100k; internal normalization applied.
Media profile modulates both positive info and misinformation exposure.

modules.name: PolicyModule
modules.description: Issues or lifts mask mandates based on risk signal; broadcasts messages and sets enforcement strength.

notes: Mandate decision is hysteresis-based using distinct thresholds.
Message effect scales with individual trust.

modules.name: VenueAttendanceModule
modules.description: Generates daily attendance at venues and forms contact pairs among attendees constrained by venue capacities.

update_rule.pseudocode:
contacts_today = []
for v in Venues:
  attendees = sample_persons_for_venue(v.type, size ~ capacity and daily_contacts_target * venue_contact_mod)
  # form random contacts within venue
  pairs = random_pairing(attendees, target_pairs = round(len(attendees) * v.contact_rate_modifier))
  for (i,j) in pairs:
    contacts_today.append((i,j,v.id,v.type))
# Household contacts separately
for hh in Households:
  members = hh.member_ids
  pairs = all_pairs_sample(members, p=venue_contact_mod_household)
  for (i,j) in pairs:
    contacts_today.append((i,j,'household', 'household'))
emit event.contacts_today
notes: Daily contacts capped by daily_contacts_cap per person.
Attendance randomness injects heterogeneity but preserves expected rates.

modules.name: SocialInfluenceModule
modules.description: Applies social influence from daily contacts and persistent network neighbors to update attitudes and compliance propensity.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for person in Persons:
  neighbors_today = {j for (i,j,_,_) in contacts_today if i==person.id} ∪ {i for (i,j,_,_) in contacts_today if j==person.id}
  if neighbors_today is empty: continue
  observed_mask_share = mean(Person[k].mask_status for k in neighbors_today)
  observed_attitude_mean = mean(Person[k].attitude_toward_masks for k in neighbors_today)
  homophily = 1 - homophily_by_mask_attitude * abs(person.attitude_toward_masks - observed_attitude_mean)/2
  weight = social_influence_strength * person.social_influence_weight * homophily
  person.attitude_toward_masks = clip((1-weight)*person.attitude_toward_masks + weight*(2*observed_mask_share-1), -2, 2)
  if state.policy_mandate_flag:
    person.compliance_propensity = clip(person.compliance_propensity + 0.05, 0, 1)
emit state.attitude_updates
notes: DeGroot-like update blending personal attitude with social observation mapped from [0,1] to [-1,1].
Homophily dampens influence when attitudes diverge.

modules.name: MaskDecisionModule
modules.description: Each person decides whether to wear a mask and which type, accounting for attitude, risk, habit, cost, and policy.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for person in Persons:
  util_attitude = person.attitude_toward_masks
  util_risk = 2*person.risk_perception - 1
  util_habit = 2*person.habit_strength - 1
  policy_boost = policy_mandate_effect * (1 if state.policy_mandate_flag else 0) * (mandate_adherence_min_compliance + (1-mandate_adherence_min_compliance)*person.compliance_propensity)
  disutility_cost = discomfort_cost + economic_cost_weight * expected_price_if_need_to_buy(person)
  latent_utility = util_attitude + 0.7*util_risk + 0.5*util_habit + policy_boost - disutility_cost
  p_wear = sigmoid(latent_utility / logistic_temperature)
  intent = bernoulli(p_wear)
  if intent:
    if has_inventory(person):
      person.mask_status = True
      person.mask_type = choose_best_inventory(person)
      decrement_inventory(person.mask_type)
    else:
      emit event.mask_intent_without_supply(person.id)
      person.mask_status = False
  else:
    person.mask_status = False
  # Habit update
  person.habit_strength = clip(habit_persistence * person.habit_strength + 0.2*(1 if person.mask_status else 0), 0, 1)
notes: Decision is logistic with interpretable utility terms.
If inventory is lacking, a purchase attempt will be handled by SupplyModule.

modules.name: SupplyModule
modules.description: Restocks inventory, adjusts prices, and processes purchase attempts by agents.

update_rule.pseudocode:
# Restock
for type in ['cloth','surgical','N95']:
  restock_qty = restock_rate_type[type] * (1 - distribution_friction) * initial_inventory_type[type]
  inventory[type] += restock_qty
# Price adjustment based on inventory tightness
for type in ['cloth','surgical','N95']:
  tightness = max(0, 1 - inventory[type]/(0.5*initial_inventory_type[type] + 1))
  price[type] = max(0.1, base_price[type] * (1 + price_adjustment_sensitivity * tightness))
# Process purchase intents
unfilled = 0; total_intents = count(event.mask_intent_without_supply)
for person_id in event.mask_intent_without_supply:
  choice = argmin_over_types(price[type])  # cheapest available type
  if inventory[choice] > 0 and person_can_afford(person_id, price[choice]) and quota_ok(person_id, purchase_rationing_limit_per_person):
    inventory[choice] -= 1
    assign_inventory_to_person(person_id, choice, qty=1)
  else:
    unfilled += 1
mask_access_gap = unfilled / max(1, total_intents)
emit observable.mask_access_gap_daily = mask_access_gap
notes: Price responds to inventory tightness; optional more complex elasticity can be added.

modules.name: EnforcementModule
modules.description: Applies venue-level enforcement; noncompliant attendees either comply temporarily or incur penalties.

notes: Enforcement effect is conditional on mandate.
Penalties and on-the-spot compliance both present.

modules.name: HouseholdNormsModule
modules.description: Reinforces household norms, shifting member attitudes and habits.

notes: Household acts as strong tie cluster.
Priority parameter tilts habit based on household leaning.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates daily observables: adoption rates overall and by venue, disparity indices, mask type distribution.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_rate = mean(person.mask_status for person in Persons)
# By-venue adoption observed among attendees
for vtype in ['household','workplace','school','retail','transit','recreation']:
  attendees = unique_agents_from_contacts(event.contacts_today, vtype)
  adoption_by_v = mean(Person[a].mask_status for a in attendees) if len(attendees)>0 else 0
  set observable.adoption_by_venue[vtype] = adoption_by_v
# Disparity by income
rates_by_income = {}
for g in ['low','mid','high']:
  group = [p for p in Persons if p.income_level == g]
  rates_by_income[g] = mean(p.mask_status for p in group)
# simple disparity index: max-min across groups
disparity_index = max(rates_by_income.values()) - min(rates_by_income.values())
# Mask type distribution among wearers
wearers = [p for p in Persons if p.mask_status]
dist = proportion_over(wearers.mask_type in ['cloth','surgical','N95'])
# Emit
emit observable.adoption_rate_daily = adoption_rate
emit observable.adoption_disparity_index_income = disparity_index
emit observable.mask_type_distribution = dist
emit observable.policy_mandate_flag_daily = 1 if state.policy_mandate_flag else 0
emit observable.risk_signal_daily = state.risk_signal
notes: Smoothing can be applied when exporting for metrics, controlled via smoothing_window_days.
Adoption by venue inferred from attendees in contacts_today.

algorithms.SocialInfluence_DeGroot: Weighted averaging of attitudes with observed peer mask use mapped to attitude space; homophily dampening.
algorithms.LogisticMaskDecision: Stochastic binary choice with latent utility from attitude, risk, habit, policy, and costs.
algorithms.VenueContactFormation: Random pairing among attendees proportional to venue modifiers and capacities with per-agent caps.
algorithms.SupplyPricing_Tightness: Price adjusts with inventory tightness: p = p0*(1 + s*(1 - inv/target)).
algorithms.MandateHysteresis: Policy toggles when risk crosses separate issue/lift thresholds to avoid oscillation.
algorithms.EnforcementDetection: Bernoulli detection with enforcement strength and noise; outcomes: on-the-spot compliance or penalty.
